# The refused set, counted per reason.
#
# `.github/scripts/corpus.sh` writes every file the run did not optimize to
# `refusals.txt` and compares this table with it: a reason whose count changed,
# or disappeared, fails the run. That is the assertion `docs/testing.md` §4 has
# been claiming since 0.10 — "the set of refused files is unchanged" — and it is
# the only thing that notices a construct that silently stops being refused and
# starts being rewritten instead (issue #36).
#
# Format: `<count><TAB><reason>`, where the reason is the clause the report shows
# — the handler prefix, the aside after `;` and any `(…)` removed, because those
# are the parts that change without meaning anything.
#
# A count that legitimately changes is updated in the same pull request that
# changes it, with the reason in the description. Reasons that are not listed
# here are reported as warnings, not failures, so a new refusal is visible
# without blocking a release on a table nobody has regenerated.
#
# Counts below are from the 0.12.1 corpus run (`tzim-ci:corpus:c012ba5`), which
# used the same pinned archives as this file's neighbours. A reason found there
# but not here was not distinguishable from its neighbours in that run's report;
# the run that adds zlib streams prints the full list, and any it reveals belong
# here.
12	more than one IFD
9	tiled layout is not supported
8	only baseline sequential
5	IFD entries are not in ascending tag order
